verdict.rationale: AI Gateway shows cost alongside requests and tokens in one dashboard across many providers (Workers AI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.). Per-request logs record provider, token usage and cost, and the product offers unified billing. Dynamic routing can enforce per-user/project/team budgets, which implies some attribution, but the evidence never shows spend reports or breakdowns grouped by model, API key, team or user. Missing for 10: documented cost breakdowns by model, key, team and user, aggregated spend reporting beyond per-request logs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
